title: AI Image Recognition & Flashcard Sorting
description: Using AI camera vision or smart tools to identify target objects and vocabulary.
suggestedActivities: Pupils observe AI smart board identifying vocabulary flashcards automatically.
Pupils test an educational AI tool by showing printed vocabulary pictures.

title: Interactive Audio & Pronunciation Practice
description: Using digital audio tools to record and compare pupil pronunciation.
suggestedActivities: Pupils listen to native audio tracks on interactive software and repeat.
Pupils use digital recorder app to record their sentence speaking.

title: Polite Communication & Gratitude
description: Developing polite greeting habits and showing gratitude to teachers, parents, and friends.
suggestedActivities: Role-play greeting classmates with 'Hello', 'Thank you', and 'Goodbye'.
Discuss polite behavior during group games.

title: Love for Nature & Classroom Cleanliness
description: Connecting lesson vocabulary (animals, nature, schoolyard) with environmental protection.
suggestedActivities: Identify nature vocabulary and practice keeping the classroom clean.
Sorting picture cards of clean vs polluted environments.

title: Shape & Color Pattern Classification
description: Integrating math, logic, and English vocabulary by sorting objects by color and shape.
suggestedActivities: Grouping school objects by color and shape using English words.
Building a simple mini-project with craft paper.

title: Self-Management & Team Collaboration
description: Fostering autonomy in preparing learning aids and collaborating in pairwork.
suggestedActivities: Pupils organize their own textbooks, workbooks, and flashcards before practice.
Pupils take turns taking leader role in group practice.
